description: A deck with notes in a supplied template without a notes master (§8.8): the house template's notes master and its theme are added under the first part names the template doesn't use (its theme is `theme1.xml`, so the notes master's is `theme2.xml`), the presentation lists the notes master, and each slide's notes page is written on it. With no font resolver, the template's fonts Brand Display and Source Serif 4 are `font_unresolved`; Brand Sans, which it embeds, isn't reported in pptx output (§3).
